$comment: Files that may import node:crypto (lint rule slate/crypto-stays-in-the-vault). One entry per file with what it uses and why. Only shrinks (tools/guards/ratchet.test.ts). Since C4, main/vault, main/sync and main/db have no entry and import no node:crypto at all (audit §4.0 invariant 1, T-STATIC-02): cryptography there runs in @slate/native. Each entry names the imports that file may use (red team 4d): a new primitive in an allowlisted file is still an error.

packages/desktop/src/main/blobs.ts.reason: createHash('sha256') names an image by its content: an identifier, not a security function (audit §4.0 invariant 1).

packages/desktop/src/main/update/electro.reason: createHash('sha512') checks a downloaded installer against the digest in the release manifest.

packages/desktop/src/main/update/signatu.reason: Ed25519 verification of the signed update feed and artefacts against the pinned public keys (C12, audit F-NIST-06); public-key operations only, no secret in the app.

packages/desktop/src/main/update/fakeBac.reason: The e2e fake update feed signs with a key pair it generates for the run (SLATE_FAKE_UPDATE, a test hook scrubbed when packaged).

packages/desktop/src/main/theme/themeSto.reason: randomUUID for a saved theme's id.
